name: 65th Anniversary of the Construction of the Berlin Wall
description: Marking 65 years since the Berlin Wall's construction, this city-wide commemorative program runs from August 13–16 and includes a temporary memorial installation at the Brandenburg Gate, an open-air exhibition, concerts, readings, historical walking tours, and talks with eyewitnesses. The focal point is a 30-meter installation on the plaza, but events span the city—offering layered engagement with Berlin's division and its ongoing resonance in memory, politics, and urban space.
